sn12.37:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati || || Nāyam bhikkhave kāyo tumhākam na pi aññesaṃ || Purāṇam idam bhikkhave kammam abhisaṅkhatam abhisañcetayitam vedaniyaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ || ||
sn12.37:2.1: Tatra kho bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako paṭiccasamuppādaññeva sādhukaṃ yoniso manasi karoti || || Iti imasmiṃ sati idaṃ hoti || imassuppādā idam uppajjati || imasmin asati idam na hoti || imassa nirodhā idam nirujjhati || Yad idam avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā || saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇam || pe|| Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti || avijjāya tveva asesavirāganirodhā saṅkhāranirodho || saṅkhāranirodhā viññāṇanirodho || pe|| evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hotīti || || pe|| || Sattamaṃ || ||
